method: Fresh agent-run paired offline replay of separately compiled byte-exact match-4 incumbent and one risk-budget proposal on reused public development bars. Each t=20..52 passes only prefix 0..t to the actual executable, resets capital=1000 and units=0, fills at t+1, marks through t+7. Both have 21-close warmup, unchanged 10/5-bar signal, ten-decimal rounding, equal costs and all-or-none cash checks. ONLY trading parameter change is nominal budget 250 to 125. Criterion declared in hypothesis-before-replay.json before running: maximum marked drawdown <=60% of old, mean net profit improvement >=0.25 dollars, identical signal counts, at least three fills and zero rejected fills. Numerical tolerance 1e-12. One proposal, no sweep. Benchmark is fully invested at same t+1 cost and t+7 mark, computed only by evaluator from already-public bars.
limitations: Only 60 previously published bars reused from match-3/agent-one/public-bars.csv, with 33 overlapping dependent episodes, not held-out evidence. Choice informed by public match-4 scoreboard and previously known negative mean profit, making half-sizing's effects on this path largely predictable. Risk reduction does not repair negative entry timing or establish positive alpha; it can worsen future bull-market benchmark gaps. Stride-seven subset has disjoint outcomes but shares history and is not independent validation. No private judge data, unseen future observations or t>59 prices used. Evaluator alone reads already-public outcome closes after decisions. No forced liquidation or terminal exit fee. Matched judge replay is unavailable: local paired testing is agent-run, not independent judge verification. The fixed 10% buffer is heuristic, not a guaranteed gap bound.
fill_policy: Next public close t+1, buy price close*1.0005 plus 0.001 fee on slipped notional. Actual emitted rounded quantity; reject entire entry if cost exceeds cash. No shorting/leverage. Terminal equity cash+units*close[t+7], no forced liquidation; costs and warmup identical. Cases reset; not a cumulative live portfolio.
